This library keeps the label and the buttons off the camera. Change what counts as being in the way, and watch them move.
Camera
Safe margins
Red is where this phone says its camera sits. Orange is how far in it says to stay on each edge.
This phone reports none
Show the camera and safe margins
Draws them over the picture: red for the camera, orange for the margins
Which edge the label sits on
Left and Right are edges of the phone rather than of the screen, so they move when you turn it
Which corner the buttons sit in
Start is the left corner of that edge in a left-to-right language, and the right one in Arabic or Hebrew
Start
End
What the label moves out of the way of
The camera
The one thing that is physically in the screen. Android reports nothing here before version 9
The curved edge
Where a phone curves down its sides. You can draw there, but a touch is unreliable
The clock and the gesture bar
Software rather than hardware, so this is off unless you want it
Leave the opposite edge alone
Stops the label growing on the far side, where its invisible box can swallow taps meant for the picture
The window itself
How far the picture may go under the camera
Always fills the whole screen, which is what a viewer wants. Never keeps the picture clear of the camera entirely
Hide the clock and the gesture bar
Swipe in from an edge to bring them back
